title: Not word-for-word — equipollent wording or necessary consequence
source_text: II. Non tamen omnia illa quae necessaria dicimus in Scriptura de verbo ad verbum reperiri, sed, vel verbis aequipollentibus, vel saltem ita ut singula ex Scriptura deduci possint per necessariam atque evidentem consequentiam, citra opem alterius fidei principii, ad quod Scriptura nos remittat, ut ex eo cognitionem uberiorem hauriamus.
pass_a_gloss: Nevertheless we do not say that all those things which we call necessary are found in Scripture word for word, but either in equivalent words, or at least so that each can be deduced from Scripture by a necessary and evident consequence, without the help of another principle of faith to which Scripture would send us so that from it we might draw a richer knowledge.
pass_b_english: We do not claim every necessary point stands in Scripture word for word.

It may stand in equivalent words, or at least so that each item can be drawn from Scripture by a necessary and clear consequence — without needing another principle of faith to which Scripture would send us for fuller knowledge.

lemmas.gloss: without the help of another principle of faith

choices.why: Denies a second faith-principle beyond Scripture.
